== Title ==
<span lang="ja">同士討ち</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">相手のキャラクターが2名以上、武器が1つ以上ある位置で戦闘が起きた場合に使う。運命数を引く。運命数＜（その位置の相手のキャラクターの数）ならば、キャラクターの1名がロストする（相手が選ぶ）。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">狭い場所で多くの銃を乱射すれば、当然、仲間を撃つ可能性も出てくる。だがストームトルーパーは、勝利を得るためには、同士討ちすらいとわない。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Friendly Fire]].

'''Lore''' — If many guns fire wildly in a cramped place, you may of course hit a comrade. Stormtroopers do not even mind friendly fire if it brings victory.

'''Game text''' — Use when a battle starts at a location where the opponent has at least two characters and at least one weapon. Draw destiny. If destiny is less than the number of opponent's characters there, one character is lost (opponent's choice).

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Title is 同士討ち. Lore says stormtroopers do not mind friendly fire for victory. Game text triggers when a battle starts rather than “an accident occurs at the beginning of a battle”.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-L-friendlyfire.gif|Original English face]], [[Friendly Fire]].</ref>
